$comment: Alexa+ MCP add-on manifest for Odobook, written from the field list in Amazon's 'Create an MCP add-on' docs. The alexa-ai CLI that validates and deploys it is partner-only, so this hasn't been through `alexa-ai deploy`; field names follow the docs, and the exact nesting may need adjusting once the toolkit opens up.

en-US.shortDescription: Log work trips hands-free. Odobook keeps your IRS mileage log or ATO 12-week car logbook as you drive.
en-US.fullDescription: Odobook keeps the car logbook a tax office expects, by voice. Say "start a work trip to the Riverside site" when you leave and "end trip, odometer 52,394" when you arrive. Odobook records the date, times, odometer readings, distance, destination and a specific business purpose for every trip, asks for a clearer purpose when "business" isn't enough, marks late entries, and keeps a running business-use percentage. It supports the IRS mileage log (miles, tax year) and the Australian ATO 12-week logbook (km). Export to CSV for your accountant at any time. Odobook keeps records; it isn't tax advice and never estimates a deduction.
examplePhrases: Alexa, tell Odobook to start a work trip to the Riverside site
Alexa, end my Odobook trip, the odometer says 52,394
Alexa, ask Odobook how much of my driving is for work
Alexa, tell Odobook I forgot yesterday's 40 mile drive to a client in Albany

en-AU.shortDescription: Log work trips hands-free. Odobook keeps your ATO 12-week car logbook as you drive.
en-AU.fullDescription: Odobook keeps your ATO 12-week logbook by voice. Say "start a work trip to Geelong" when you leave and "end trip, odometer 52,394" when you arrive. Odobook records the dates, odometer readings, km, destination and a specific purpose for every journey, as the ATO asks, flags vague purposes and late entries, warns if a first-year logbook would run past 30 June, and keeps a running business-use percentage. Export to CSV for your tax agent. Odobook keeps records; it isn't tax advice.
examplePhrases: Alexa, tell Odobook to start a work trip to Geelong
Alexa, end my Odobook trip, the odometer says 52,394
Alexa, ask Odobook how my logbook is going
Alexa, tell Odobook I forgot yesterday's 112 km site inspection in Ballarat
